test_method: low-volume sequential HTTPS health/web/API smoke; synthetic Playwright journey; isolated session/database and injected frontend error regressions

reported_failure.symptom: Plan data reload displayed a Korean load-failure message after initial public demo access.

actual_result.candidate_change: Bounded retry/classification for Public Demo GET failures; POST requests remain non-retried.
actual_result.local_regressions: Frontend injected error mapping/retry tests and isolated backend session/reset tests passed.
actual_result.separate_historical_health_503: Confirmed prior code mechanism was session-capacity exhaustion on health probes; distinct from current plan reload report.

limitation: The original failed endpoint/status and Render logs were unavailable.
The smoke and browser journey exercised the currently deployed service, not the un-deployed candidate SHA.
Observed first-request latency does not prove cold start caused the reported plan reload failure.
No production database/session state was reset or inspected.
